lines: I am now in a silent sky.
I exhaled a cloud named loneliness.
The cloud lets rain fall, and a rainbow appears.
Even though I’ll never catch it.
I want to keep repeating my first kiss.
Love bites at me.
It says it won’t let go.
The shape of loneliness seems unchanged.
Soar upward.
Someday beyond the night.
Your song shines so much it’s nauseating.
Of days where kindness has grown murky.
Melancholy feels like a crowded train.
The cooled warmth.
I threw it recklessly.
Even if I believe in love.
It will surely disappear, I guess.
Then I don’t need it; it’s too sad.
Even goodbye.
Because I can’t say it properly.
Instead of waving, I tried hugging.
I saw a shooting star, I saw a shooting star.
My song of wishes.
Just being by your side was truly happy.
Just being by your side, that alone.
Love bites at me.
It says it won’t let go.
The shape of loneliness seems unchanged.
Soar upward.
Someday beyond the night.
Your song shines so much it’s nauseating.
I won’t get hurt anymore, I won’t hurt anyone anymore.
Shine, your song.
